title: Monotone Convergence of a Recursive Sequence
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Let a_1 = 1 and a_{n+1} = sqrt(2 + a_n). Prove the sequence converges and find its limit.

steps.title: Prove Sequence is Bounded by 2
steps.explanation: By induction, a_n < 2 for all n.

steps.title: Prove Sequence is Monotonically Increasing
steps.mathExpression: a_{n+1} - a_n = \sqrt{2 + a_n} - a_n = \frac{2 + a_n - a_n^2}{\sqrt{2 + a_n} + a_n} = \frac{(2 - a_n)(1 + a_n)}{\sqrt{2 + a_n} + a_n} > 0
steps.explanation: Since 0 < a_n < 2, the numerator is strictly positive.

steps.title: Solve for the Limit L
steps.explanation: Since a_n > 0, L must be positive, so L = 2.
